name: dotnet
description: C# language support, build tasks and the Roslyn language server.

dotnet.defaultSolution.description: The path of the default solution to be opened in the workspace when multiple solutions are available.

dotnet.dotnetPath.description: Specifies the path to a dotnet installation directory to use instead of the default system one. Example: "/home/username/mycustomdotnetdirectory".

dotnet.explorer.groupInFileExplorer.description: Group project files in the Explorer the way Solution Explorer does.

dotnet.formatting.preserveCommentIndenta.description: Keep the indentation of comment lines when formatting.

dotnet.layout.enabled.description: Show the memory layout of types as inline hints.

dotnet.layout.fieldOffsets.description: Show the byte offset of each field in the memory layout hints.

dotnet.navigation.preferImplementation.description: Go to Definition on an abstract or interface member navigates to the single implementation when there is exactly one.

dotnet.projects.maxAutoLoad.description: The maximum number of projects loaded automatically when no solution is found.

dotnet.server.environmentVariables.description: Custom environment variables to pass to the language server process. Specify as key-value pairs, for example: { "DOTNET_GCName": "libclrgc.dylib" }. (Requires extension restart)

dotnet.server.logLevel.description: Sets the logging level for the language server.

dotnet.server.path.description: Specifies the absolute path to the server (LSP or O#) executable. When left empty the version pinned to the C# Extension is used. (Requires extension restart)

markdownEnumDescriptions: Source generators are executed after an explicit user action, including save, build, or the [Rerun source generators](command:csharp.rerunSourceGenerators) command.
Source generators are executed automatically as the user types.
dotnet.server.sourceGeneratorExecution.markdownDescription: Controls when source generators are executed. (Requires extension restart)

dotnet.server.useServerGC.description: Configure the language server to use .NET server garbage collection.  Server garbage collection generally provides better performance at the expense of higher memory consumption. (Requires extension restart)

dotnet.solution.path.description: The path of the solution to open when the workspace loads. Overrides dotnet.defaultSolution.
